answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1306 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the voyage. The crystal index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the jade queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. A 173 account operation therefore ties up 16 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
